pairs.why: A's shell and keys are softer, satin and flat-lit like the real calculator, while B has crisper specular rims and more lacquered key tops.
B has smooth planks, chunky rope wraps and plain sand like the real card, while A's busy caustic water net adds texture the real card lacks.
A's hat has a soft satin finish with diffuse shading like the real hat and cap, while B's black brim and cone look more lacquered, with a stronger sheen.
A is a smooth, simple, soft-highlighted plastic like the real bottle, while B adds noisy water droplets and speckled surface detail the real card doesn't have.
A's leaves are smaller, tighter and softer-lit like the real topiary, while B's big glossy leaves have strong highlights and look like lacquered plastic.
A's duck has smooth plastic with soft highlights and a closed mouth, while B has more glossy wet-looking speculars in the open mouth and a grainier sand scatter.
Both show similar smooth marble-like stone, though B's crisper veining is slightly more texture-y than the real stone, so I lean A only weakly.
